intent_en: Compare the stated first-year restaurant failure rate with the first-year and three-year reality rates to quantify each reported share.
narration_support: Regardless, it's not an easy feat.
chart_support: An infographic illustration displaying the text 'NOT SUPER EASY' alongside cutlery, visually reinforcing the difficulty of the restaurant business.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly states that success is not easy and discusses high failure rates (without using specific numbers in the intent), while the image graphic reinforces this with the text 'NOT SUPER EASY' and dining symbols.
narrative_goal: Show that while the 90% first-year restaurant failure myth is false, about 30% still fail in the first year and roughly 60% fail after three years.
current_model_input: Compare the stated first-year restaurant failure rate with the first-year and three-year reality rates to quantify each reported share.
